# A&S Contracting Services

> A&S Contracting Services is a general contractor in Warrenton, Missouri, founded in 2023 by Blake Alger. It self-performs roofing, siding, gutters, soffit, fascia, windows and doors, interior and exterior work, drywall, and general contracting for residential and commercial clients within 50 miles of Warrenton.

## Business Information
- Company: A&S Contracting Services
- Type: General contractor
- Location: Warrenton, Missouri 63383 (Warren County); no street address published
- Service radius: 50 miles from Warrenton
- Founded: 2023
- Owner: Blake Alger
- Credentials: Licensed Missouri general contractor, fully insured (no license number is published)

- Hours: Monday-Friday 7am-6pm, Saturday 8am-3pm

## About
Blake Alger founded A&S Contracting Services in 2023 with a focus on roofing and exterior work, and the company expanded to the full list of services below. A&S performs its own work with no subcontractors, and the same crew stays on a project from start to finish. Every project closes with a final walkthrough, and the job site is kept clean daily.

## Services
- Roofing: installation, repair, tear-off and full replacement; storm and hail damage repair; insurance claim documentation; architectural asphalt shingles, impact-resistant shingles, and metal roofing. Residential and commercial. https://ascontractingservices.com/services/roofing/
- Siding: installation and repair in vinyl, fiber cement, and wood. https://ascontractingservices.com/services/siding/
- Gutters: seamless aluminum gutter systems; installation, repair, full replacement, cleaning, and maintenance. https://ascontractingservices.com/services/gutters/
- Soffit: installation and repair; attic ventilation; blocks pests and moisture; matched to the roofline. https://ascontractingservices.com/services/soffit/
- Fascia: installation and replacement; rotted board replacement; protects roof edges; matched finish. https://ascontractingservices.com/services/fascia/
- Windows & Doors: energy-efficient replacement windows, patio doors, entry doors, and weather sealing. https://ascontractingservices.com/services/windows-doors/
- Full Scale Interior Work: drywall, flooring, painting, trim, custom finishes, room additions, and full interior remodels. https://ascontractingservices.com/services/full-scale-interior-work/
- Exterior Work: siding, roofing, and gutter integration; full exterior renovations. https://ascontractingservices.com/services/exterior-work/
- Dry Wall: installation, finishing, and repair for residential and commercial projects. https://ascontractingservices.com/services/dry-wall/
- General Contracting: residential and commercial projects managed from planning to completion. https://ascontractingservices.com/services/general-contracting/
- All services: https://ascontractingservices.com/services/

## Estimates and Pricing
A&S publishes no prices. Each project is priced from an on-site visit and a written, itemized estimate. The visit and the estimate are free and carry no obligation. Cost depends on square footage, the materials selected, the condition of the existing structure, and the scope of work. A&S states there are no hidden fees or upselling and that the quoted price is the final price. Estimates are scheduled within days of first contact, and start windows and timelines are given in writing.

## Timeframes
- Most single-family roof replacements: 1-3 days, weather permitting
- Siding: varies by square footage and home size
- Interior work: depends on scope

## Insurance Claims
For storm and hail damage, A&S documents the damage with photos, provides a detailed itemized estimate, meets the insurance adjuster on site, and helps the homeowner through the claim.
